title: Iran — Mahsa Amini Protests 2022
description: Protestas tras muerte de Mahsa Amini en custodia policial. Contagio rápido vía redes sociales a pesar de internet shutdown. Movimiento 'Woman, Life, Freedom'.
sources: Iran Human Rights (IHR): protest casualty data
data_notes: P represents fraction_participating (units: fraction_participating). Series reconstructed from published research sources (empirical_estimated).
